title: Build a population-genetics Markov chain (Moran or Wright-Fisher) — populationGeneticsModel
text: Moran model. step one individual chosen reproduce (probability proportional type's relative fitness, mutant fitness \(r=1+s\) wild-type fitness \(1\)) one individual, chosen uniformly random, dies replaced offspring, mutates probability u v depending parent's type. interior state \(\) (\(0<<n\)), writing \(r_i=(1+s)\) \(m_i=n-\), $$P_{,-1}=\frac{}{n}\cdot\frac{r_i v + m_i(1-u)}{r_i+m_i},\qquad   P_{,+1}=\frac{m_i}{n}\cdot\frac{r_i(1-u) + m_i v}{r_i+m_i},$$ \(P_{ii}\) remainder. Wright-Fisher model. Generations discrete non-overlapping: interior state \(\), mutant-allele frequency \(k=/n\) first updated mutation, \(p=k(1-u)+(1-k)v\), viability selection, \(p'=\min\bigl(p(1+s)/(1+ps),\,1\bigr)\), next generation's mutant count \(\mathrm{Binomial}(n,p')\)-distributed: \(P_{ij}=\binom{n}{j}p'^{\,j}(1-p')^{n-j}\). constructions follow PyDTMC's population_genetics_model, one deliberate difference: function uses mutant relative fitness \(1+s\) models (PyDTMC's Moran implementation instead uses \(1-s\), positive s favours wild-type rather mutant, opposite Wright-Fisher convention usual textbook one). s = 0 (neutral drift) mutation-rate terms unaffected choice match PyDTMC exactly; away s = 0 two packages' Moran chains differ construction, design, keep s's meaning consistent "moran" "wright-fisher" within package. u, v shrink 0, reduce classical drift-chains absorbing loss/fixation states, going back Wright (1931) Moran (1958); see Ewens (2004) modern textbook treatment .

title: Discretize an AR(1) process into a Markov chain (Rouwenhorst's method) — rouwenhorst
text: grid \(n=\code{size}\) evenly spaced points spanning \([\alpha-\psi,\ \alpha+\psi]\) \(\psi=\sigma_y\sqrt{n-1}\), \(\sigma_y=\sigma/\sqrt{1-\rho^2}\) process's unconditional standard deviation: particular width (rather fixed multiple \(\sigma_y\) tauchen) method needs order match AR(1)'s variance first-order autocorrelation exactly every size, including rho near \(\pm1\). transition matrix built recursively. Let \(\theta=(1+\rho)/2\) , two states, $$\Theta_2 = \begin{pmatrix}\theta & 1-\theta\\ 1-\theta & \theta\end{pmatrix}.$$ \(m\) states (\(2<m\le n\)), form \(m\times m\) matrix four \((m-1)\times(m-1)\) corner blocks built \(\Theta_{m-1}\) (weighted \(\theta\) \(1-\theta\) following standard Rouwenhorst recursion), divide every interior row (first last) \(2\) restore row-stochasticity, since rows receive contributions two overlapping corner blocks. Rouwenhorst's method reproduces AR(1)'s unconditional variance lag-1 autocorrelation \(\rho\) exactly, every size (Kopecky Suen (2010) find outperforms tauchen several methods across persistence range typically seen quarterly macroeconomic actuarial time series, e.g. discretized short-rate inflation processes reserving ALM work).
